title: EditionFingerprint
description: Edition fingerprint identifying an exact, reproducible document edition and normalization configuration. Normative rule: an edition fingerprint missing any version field (profile_version, normalization_version) is strictly invalid because text offsets and locators depend directly on the normalizer and profile semantics.

doc_id.description: Stable publication or work identifier (e.g. URN or UUID).

content_hash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic hex digest of the raw source publication content or package document.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag (e.g. 'zh-Hans', 'en', 'ja') or 'generic' for the fallback profile.

profile_version.description: Semantic version string of the language profile used during extraction and normalization. Normative rule: required; missing version invalidates the fingerprint.

normalization_version.description: Semantic version string of the text normalization engine. Normative rule: required; missing version invalidates the fingerprint.

spine_order.description: Ordered sequence of spine item paths (hrefs) or item IDs defining the reading order.
